long_biography.plain_text:
Patrick Caranta built his business profile in Sainte-Maxime through food retail and a network of related companies. He has served as president of Gescod Provence since 2005, directing a holding company established in 1984. His mandates also span Carrefour Market operations, supermarkets, real-estate vehicles and management businesses across the Var and Alpes-Maritimes.

Caranta's current corporate network is notably family-operated. Gescod Provence lists Chantal Caranta and the younger Paul and Vincent Caranta among its directors, while Patrick remains president. His other documented mandates include supermarket company Saint Anne d'Evenos Distribution and retail-linked SA du Rond Point. He is a long-serving operator and family business principal whose core activity combines grocery retail, holding-company oversight and property investment.
